title: Scaffold a hyperfrontend feature
description: Scaffold a feature by delegating to the @hyperfrontend/features SDK (hf init) headlessly.

contract.description: Path to the feature contract file, relative to the target directory.
contract.x-prompt: Where is the feature contract file?

entry.description: Entry file the generated glue import is wired into.
entry.x-prompt: Which entry file should the glue import be wired into?

directory.description: Directory to scaffold into, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the root.

url.description: URL the generated connector loads the feature from.
